title: Per-device results of a GPU without a DevLab runner (fleet/devices/<name>.json)
description: One file per GPU. Per model of the fleet: whether it fits, the largest context it admits, how to serve it, preset overrides and, when measured, evidence with its provenance. make_info.py build reads the entry of a card's model and writes the card's devices entry, the GPU's preset and the evidence from it; render_card.py shows the GPU only where the entry says it fits. Checked by card_lib.validate_device_results (the subset of JSON Schema info_schema.json uses) and by `make_info.py devices --check`.

device.description: The GPU id, a skills/loom-kb/device/<family>/<id> registry device (radeon-rx9070xt, gfx1150)

gpu.description: The board as the session found it (name, die, memory), for readers of the file

same_programs_as.description: A GPU whose programs and preset this one serves unchanged (radeon-rx9070xt: radeon-r9700); the GPU's preset is derived from that GPU's preset when the package has one

share_section_with.description: A GPU whose performance section this one shares: the card prints one section headed with both names ("Radeon AI PRO R9700 / RX 9070 XT") and the entries here carry no evidence. null/absent: this GPU has its own section

preset.description: When the GPU gets its own preset `<first><registry preset_suffix>` (chat-9070xt, chat-gfx1150), written into model.json by make_info.py build; the programs, weights and the other presets are never touched

always.description: true: every model that fits gets the preset (context_capacity = its max_context). false/absent: only a model whose entry has `execution` overrides or whose max_context is below the base preset's context_capacity; every other model reuses the default preset

sdk.description: The SDK the results were produced with: {hrx_loom, note}

tool.description: How max_context was found (script, step, confirmation)

package.description: What was served (the published package, its default preset, fetched with loom-fetch)

serve.description: Serving settings common to the file's models (device flag, memory, backing); a model's own serve_args are what the card prints

provenance.description: Where the file's results come from: a source block (kind machine; device {cpu, gpu, os} names the machine; hrx_loom the SDK). Evidence documents without a `source` of their own are not allowed: a session carries its own, this is the default a data-collection script copies into them

models.description: Keyed by fleet slug (fleet/<slug>), e.g. bartowski-Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-loom

fits.description: The package loads and serves on this GPU. false: the card does not mention the GPU for this model

reason.description: fits false: why (one factual line, not shown on the card)

max_context.description: Tokens per request the GPU admits (largest context confirmed by one request of that length that completes). Required when fits. The card says `serves up to N tokens` when this is below the native context, and the GPU's preset sets context_capacity = max_context

native_context.description: The package's native context when the session recorded it (informational)

serve_args.description: The loom-serve flags the card prints for this GPU and model (after --model and --device), e.g. ["--memory_bytes=15000000000", "--state_slab_bytes=4mib"]. Absent: the GPU's registry flags

execution.description: Preset overrides over the base preset's execution (SDK 0.2 keys). Written into the GPU's preset together with context_capacity = max_context

note.description: One factual line for readers of the file (not shown on the card)

evidence.description: loom-card-evidence/2 documents of this GPU for this model, as make_info.py perf / gates / roofline write them (perf: --source-kind machine --gpu <device>); build merges them like any evidence file. Only `performance`, `gates`, `roofline` and `gpu` keys. Not allowed when share_section_with is set
